test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

RK Laxman was well-known for his__** drawings of people in such a highly exaggerated manner as to cause laughter**__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Caricatures**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Caricatures"** refers to drawings or illustrations that exaggerate certain features of a person or subject in a humorous or satirical way. (व्यंगचित्र)

 
 
• **Example:** The artist drew caricatures of famous politicians, highlighting their unique facial features in an amusing manner.
 
 
 
• **"Drawings of people in such a highly exaggerated manner as to cause laughter"** is the definition of caricatures, which fits perfectly in the given sentence. (व्यंग्यात्मक चित्रण)
 
 
• **Example:** RK Laxman was well-known for his caricatures of the common man, which captured the essence of India's socio-political climate.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Caricatures**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Articles **(लेख): Written compositions or pieces often found in newspapers, magazines, or journals.

 
 
• **Example:** She wrote several articles on environmental conservation for the local newspaper.
 
 
 
• **Sketches **(रेखाचित्र): Rough or quick drawings often made without much detail.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist created a quick sketch of the scenery before starting the painting.
 
 
 
• **Portraits **(चित्र): Artistic representations, especially of a person, focusing on their likeness and personality.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum displayed portraits of royal family members from the 18th century.

The correct answer is** option 2.**
